title: Bootstrap do Repositório, Topologia Canónica, MentionDTO e Dynamic Connector Registry

git.gitignore: canonical .gitignore created covering caches, .env, sqlite, and temp files

configuration.settings_yaml: valid (4 sections: app, storage, engine, rate_limiting)
configuration.sources_yaml: valid (9 connectors defined with modules, rate limits, and auth flags)
configuration.keywords_yaml: valid (Honda, Kawasaki, Suzuki, Yamaha models, Gen2/Gen24/Gen25, intents, and negative filters)

data_model.validation: strict immutable frozen dataclass, score bounds clipping, auto-viral threshold at 10,000 views
data_model.hashing: SHA-256 deterministic hex digest via MentionDTO.generate_id
data_model.serialization: to_dict() and from_dict() verified lossless roundtrip

connectors.fault_tolerance: TimeoutError -> PARTIAL_DEGRADED, Exception -> ERROR, telemetry tracking latency in ms
